# Peptides of China

> B2B sourcing platform for research peptides manufactured in China. Factory-direct sourcing, batch-tested purity, international shipping. All products are for laboratory research use only.

## Key Pages

- [Catalog](https://peptidesofchina.com/catalog/): full china peptide catalog
- [Latest Price List (PDF)](https://peptidesofchina.com/pricelist.pdf): all catalog prices — USD per box, 10 vials per box
- [How It Works](https://peptidesofchina.com/how-it-works/): no-deposit request process, Express shipping $97–127, 7–12 days
- [Peptide Quality](https://peptidesofchina.com/peptide-quality/): testing and documentation
- [FAQ](https://peptidesofchina.com/faq/): common sourcing questions
- [Contact](https://peptidesofchina.com/contact/): inquiries and specifications
- [Research Use Disclaimer](https://peptidesofchina.com/research-use-disclaimer/)
